scope: 主会话MCP只读回读；全量记录一致性另见数据库逐记录核验.json

value.label: 候选定义数量
value.query: MATCH (n:ModelDefinition) WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH 'kgmodel:single:v01:' RETURN n.kind AS kind,count(*) AS count ORDER BY kind

value.label: 命名空间与实例标签隔离
value.query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH 'kgmodel:single:v01:' RETURN count(n) AS candidateNodes, sum(CASE WHEN n:Dwelling OR n:Building OR n:Space OR n:Element THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS domainInstanceLabels,collect(DISTINCT n.sourceHash) AS sourceHashes

value.label: 图边边界
value.query: MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) RETURN sum(CASE WHEN a.uid STARTS WITH 'kgmodel:single:v01:' AND b.uid STARTS WITH 'kgmodel:single:v01:' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS candidateEdges,sum(CASE WHEN (a.uid STARTS WITH 'kgmodel:single:v01:') <> (b.uid STARTS WITH 'kgmodel:single:v01:') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS crossingEdges

value.label: 体量错落依据路径
value.query: MATCH (i:ModelResearchItem {uid:'kgmodel:single:v01:ModelResearchItem:B402'})-[r]->(n) RETURN type(r) AS relation,collect(n.name) AS targets ORDER BY relation
